I will put some chemical fertilizer on this maize plot because maize needs it and I cannot leave the land without feeding it, but I will use less than the full package because money is tight. I will plant improved seed if I can get it, since it performs better when I also use fertilizer. I will not irrigate because we depend on the rains, and I do not expect to use pesticide on this small plot. My family will do most of the work, and I may hire a little help at weeding or harvest.
